title: Agent adoption: separate endpoint panels
chart_rules: These four panels measure different populations and units. Never combine them into a global agent count.
Use categorical interval labels or endpoint dots. Do not invent monthly observations or fit an exponential through the endpoints.
If joining endpoints, use a thin dotted connector explicitly labelled as a visual guide, not an observed path.
Preserve inequalities. OpenAI reported more than sixfold growth and more than five million weekly users; exact values are undisclosed.
Company telemetry is self-reported. JetBrains is a tool vendor surveying other vendors' users; it is not a disinterested census.
Use November 2026 through October 2027 for the forecast, separate from all historical observations here.

panels.title: Active agents inside Microsoft 365
panels.population: Microsoft 365 Copilot Agents platform and SharePoint agents; all countries and customer segments
panels.method: Unique agent identities active during a rolling 28-day window. Activity requires user-initiated use on at least one day or completion of at least one autonomous run. Creation surfaces: Agent Builder and Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
caveats: Includes user-invoked assistants and autonomous runs
Not people, full-time workers, transactions or revenue

panels.title: People using Codex each week
panels.method: OpenAI reports weekly active users but does not disclose the precise qualifying event, week boundaries or baseline count in this article.
caveats: The February baseline is tied to the desktop launch, not a disclosed precise observation week
Do not calculate an exact baseline by dividing 5 million by six; both are inequalities
One user can run multiple agents and tasks

distribution_event.description: Desktop app launched on macOS; temporary Free/Go access and higher paid-plan limits accompanied the launch.

panels.title: Developers using coding agents at work
panels.evidence_type: Developer survey by another developer-tools vendor
panels.population: Professional developers in JetBrains' Developer Ecosystem research
panels.method: The May-July 2026 survey contains more than 15,000 professional developers worldwide. Regional quotas and weighting account for geography, employment, language and JetBrains familiarity. These are survey waves, not a longitudinal panel.
caveats: Respondents can use multiple tools, so series are not mutually exclusive market shares
Survey estimates, not audited user totals
Show the May-July interval rather than an invented single date

panels.title: EU small-business users of Codex or ChatGPT Work
panels.population: EU business accounts with at most 200 associated users
panels.method: Weekly active users of either ChatGPT Work or Codex, relative to the May 1-7 baseline. This source's SMB definition is account size, not the standard employee-based legal definition.
caveats: The product set expands when ChatGPT Work launches in July
Growth reflects availability and distribution as well as changing behavior

distribution_event.description: ChatGPT Work launched across paid-plan audiences in stages. The EU report attributes much of the growth to its introduction.

additional_cross_checks.metric: Daily AI-agent requests on Cloudflare's network
additional_cross_checks.caveat: Requests, not unique agents, human principals or purchases; network coverage and agent classification matter.

additional_cross_checks.metric: OpenClaw GitHub interest as of August 26
additional_cross_checks.caveat: Approximate repository popularity, not deployed installations. Began as a personal weekend project in November 2025.

cost_evidence.metric: Cost to achieve fixed benchmark performance, including reasoning-token consumption
cost_evidence.method: Five benchmark families spanning mathematics, science and games; estimates compare price-performance frontiers.
caveats: Benchmark costs are not full business-workflow costs
The cheapest capable model is not necessarily the customer's chosen model
A historical average is not a promised forward decline
Review, integration, errors, latency, tools and acquisition can dominate total costs
